invariants.rationale: The method assumes the input parameter is not null, as it is dereferenced without a null check.
The method calls putAll on this.properties, which means it must be non-null.
The method accesses properties.properties and passes it to putAll, so it is required to be non-null.
After adding all entries from properties.properties to this.properties, the size of this.properties must be at least as large as properties.properties.
After the call, this.properties must contain all keys that were present in properties.properties.
